s: Hilkot pesach yesh biklalan shemoneh mitzvot, shalosh mitzvot aseh vechamesh mitzvot lo taaseh, vezehu peratan: a. Shello leekol chametz beyom y"d mechatzot hayyom ulemala: b. Lebaer chametz min haolam mechatzot hayyom ulemala: g. Shello yeraeh chametz kol shiba: d. Shello yimmatze chametz kol shiba: h. Shello leekol chametz kol shiba: v. Shello leekol kol shiba taarobet chametz sheyyesh bo kezzayit bikde akilat peras mehattaarobet, ap al pi shebbaakilat hattaarobet en toamim kelal hechametz shebbetoko, veen notenim betoko et hechametz ella leqiyyuha beolma, kegon kutach (perush nasyoba dachalaba) habbabli, shemmeporerin betoko perure lechem chametz lehachmitzo, sheen bakkutach taam hallechem, ella chamitzut hallechem hechmitz et hakkutach, shekkayyotze bazeh bishar issurin en kan issur min hattora, abal bechametz bepesach hechemira tora veomra. "Kol machmetzet lo tokelu", apillu taarobto. Abal karet eno chayyab, ella im ken yesh betaarobto taam chametz kemo bishar issurim, ukemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"b ubeyoreh dea siman tz"a: z. Leekol matztza belel t"v benisan: ch. Lesapper bitziat mitzrayim beoto hallayla: minhag yeme nisan ubo y"t seipim: chakamim harishonim tiqqenu bizman shebbet hammiqdash haya qayyam, sheyyatchilu haddarshanim lidrosh barabbim hilkot haregel sheloshim yom lipne haregel, dehaynu shemmippurim vaelak yidreshu hilkot pesach, umechamishsha beiyyar vaelak yidreshu hilkot atzeret, umi"d beelul vaelak yidreshu hilkot hechag, lepi shekkol echad veechad haddar beeretz yisrael chayyab lehabi baregel g' qorbanot, olat reiyya veshalme chagiga veshalme simcha, vekol qorban tzarik lihyot naqi mikkol mum umishshear debarim happoselim et haqqorban, lepikak tiqqenu chakamim lidrosh hilkot haregel sheloshim yom lepanayv, kede lehazkir haam et haregel, shello yishkechu lehakin behemot hakkesherim leqorban, veyihyeh lahem shehut kol sheloshim yom:

Vetaqqana zo lo nitbattela miyyisrael ap leachar shecharab bet hammiqdash, shekkol chakam haya shoneh letalmidayv hilkot haregel sheloshim yom lepanayv, kede sheyyihyu beqiim behilkotayv veyedeu hammaaseh asher yaasun, velahamon am hayu doreshim hilkot haregel bashshabbat shellepanayv, shebbeshabbat zo hayu mitqabbetzin kol haam mikkol hakkeparim lishmoa hilkot haregel mippi hechakam. Lepikak, nahagu baddorot haacharonim shehechakam doresh hilkot pesach bashshabbat shellepanayv im eno ereb pesach, vehilkot hechag doresh beshabbat shuba (abal atzeret en bo halakot meyuchadot, shekkol issur vehetter hannohagin bo nohagin gam ken bepesach vesukkot). Vehaiqqar lidrosh ulehorot lahem darke Hashem ulelammed lahem hammaaseh asher yaasun, velo kemo shennohagin akshav:

Ubaddorot hallalu sheen hechakam shoneh letalmidayv halakot (lepi shehakkol katub basseper), mitzva al kol echad veechad sheyyilmod hilkot haregel qodem haregel ad sheyyihyeh baqi bahem veyeda hammaaseh asher yaaseh:

Mosheh rabbenu alayv hashshalom tiqqen lahem leyisrael sheyyihyeh kol chakam hair doresh libne iro bekol regel beinyano shel yom nes hannaasa bo bayyom, kegon bepesach bitziat mitzrayim, ubaatzeret bemattan tora, ubechag beheqqep anene kabod. Vegam ken yidrosh laam bekol regel halakot hatztzerikot lebo bayyom, sheyyodia lahem haasur vehammuttar bo bayyom, hilkot pesach bepesach, vehilkot atzeret baatzeret, vehilkot chag bechag, ap al pi sheddarash lahem hilkot haregel sheloshim yom lepanayv. Veakshav en nohagin lidrosh halakot bachag atzmo (lepi shehakkol katub basseper), ella doreshin beaggada meinyano shel yom, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tqk"t:

Minhag pashut bekol yisrael shekkol qahal veqahal mesimim mas al bene iran letzorek chittim lepesach liqnotam ulechalleqam laaniyye iran. Vekol mi sheddar bair y"b chodesh naasa kibne hair, vechayyab litten mas immahem lazeh. Vaapillu talmide chakamim happeturin mimmas notenin chelqam, lepi shetztzedaqa hi zo. Vekol ani haddar bair y"b chodesh naasa kaaniyye hair, vechayyabin bene hair litten lo chittim lepesach. Veakshav merob haggalut nahagu haam din sheloshim yom, shekkol mi sheddar bair sheloshim yom naasa kibne hair, vekopin oto litten immahem letzorek chittim lepesach. Veken kol ani haddar bair sheloshim yom naasa kaaniyye hair, vechayyabim bene hair litten lo chittim lepesach:

Vekol zeh shebba lair lagur sham veomer sheeno rotzeh lehishtaqqea sham. Abal mi shebba lair lehishtaqqea sham, naasa kibne hair miyyad, vekopin oto litten immahem letzorek chittim lepesach. Veken ani shebba lair kede lehishtaqqea sham naasa kaaniyye hair, vechayyabim litten lo chittim lepesach:

Veani sheen dato lehishtaqqea bair velo shaha sheloshim yom, ap al pi sheen bene hair chayyabim litten lo chittim, mikkol maqom chayyabim litten lo matztza bepesach kederek shechayyabim litten lo pat bekol yemot hashshana, mezon shette seudot lekol yom veyom mimot hachol shehu shoheh bair, ubeshabbat mezon shalosh seudot, kemo shekkatub beyoreh dea siman rn"v ayyen sham:

Nohagin bimdinot ellu shebbekol chodesh nisan en omerim tachanun, velo "vehu rachum" beb' veHashem, velo "yehi ratzon" sheachar qeriat hattora, velo tzv"tz shebbemincha beshabbat. Veen mazkirin neshamot kelal (vehu haddin sheen omerim "ab harachamim"), chutz mibbayyom haacharon shel pesach. Veen omerim tzidduq haddin veqaddish shelleacharayv, apillu haya hammet talmid chakam muplag ugedol haddor, ella doreshin alayv veomerim qaddish achar hadderasha im hu talmid chakam apillu eno muplag. Abal im eno talmid chakam, en doreshin alayv veen maspidin alayv, sheen maspidin bekol hachodesh ella lechakam bepanayv, dehaynu beod shello niqbar:

Veen mitannin bekol chodesh nisan apillu taanit yachid. Veen tzarik lomar sheen gozerin taanit al hatztzibbur bekol hachodesh. Vekol debarim ellu enam meiqqar haddin, ella hem minhag shennahagu baddorot haacharonim, vesameku al mah sheameru chakamim shebbe' benisan hitchilu hannesiim lehaqrib et qorbenehem lachanukkat hammizbeach, "nasi echad layyom" ad y"g benisan, vekol nasi beyom shehiqrib qorbano haya yom tob shello, veereb pesach hu yom tob lekol yisrael shehayu maqribin happesach, veen kan panuy ella yom y"g shello haya bo yom tob, veachar kak ch' yeme happesach hen yamim tobim, im ken yatza rob hachodesh biqdushsha, lepikak nohagin laasot kullo qodesh keen yom tob. Veen mitannin apillu beereb rosh chodesh iyyar. Vaapillu taanit yom shemmet bo abiv veimmo (sheqqorin yar-tzayyt) en mitannin bekol hachodesh. Abal hechatan vehakkalla beyom chuppatam nohagin lehitannot apillu berosh chodesh nisan, mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman tqa"g:

Ulepi sheissur hattaanit bekol chodesh zeh, chutz mishshabbatot veyamim tobim verosh chodesh vechullo shel moed, eno ella minhag, lepikak hammitanneh bo taanit chalom (sheapillu beshabbat veyom tob muttar lehitannot taanit chalom, kemo shennitbaer besiman rp"ch) — en tzarik lesheb betaanit bechodesh iyyar kede sheyyekuppar lo al mah shechata shehitanna bechodesh nisan al chalomo, kemo shetztzarik laasot mi shemmitanneh taanit chalom beshabbat veyom tob verosh chodesh vechullo shel moed, shehu tzarik lesheb betaanit al taanito, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ty"ch:

Mi shehitanna taanit chalom beshabbat shebbechodesh nisan, muttar lehitannot lemachar beyom rishon al mah shehitanna beshabbat, kevan sheissur hattaanit zeh eno ella minhag. Vaapillu im chal rosh chodesh nisan beechad bashshabbat ubeshabbat shellepanayv hitanna taanit chalom, muttar lo lesheb betaanit berosh chodesh nisan al mah shehitanna beshabbat, kemo shennitbaer besiman rp"ch, ayyen sham hattaam:

Bekol hachodesh, ap sheen omerim tachanun, omerim "lamnatztzeach yaanka vego'", ubesheni vachamishi omerim "el erek appayim", abal beereb pesach en omerim "lamnatztzeach" ve"el erek appayim", veen ereb pesach domeh lishar ereb yom tob, ki hu atzmo yom tob, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"ch:
Beereb pesach vechullo shel moed en omerim "mizmor letoda", mittaam shennitbaer besiman n"a, ayyen sham:
Litten cherem bebet hakkeneset leezeh tzorek gadol muttar bekol chodesh nisan, ap al pi sheasur betishre, mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman tr"b:
Nohagin merosh chodesh vaelak liqrot parashat hannasi shehiqrib bo bayyom, ubeyom y"g parashat "behaaloteka" ad "ken asa et hammenora", shehu neged shebet levi:
Beereb pesach shacharit mashkimin lebet hakkeneset, kede sheyyigmor seudato qodem shaa d', ayyen siman tm"g:

Kol haoseh issur (perush agudda) lechag baakila ushetiyya, dehaynu shemmarbeh qetzat baakila ushetiyya bayyom shelleachar hechag, veosehu tapel lechag, maaleh alayv hakkatub keillu bana mizbeach vehiqrib alayv qorban, shenneemar "isru chag baabotim (uperusho. Behemot abot ushemenot) ad qarnot hammizbeach". Lepikak nohagin bimdinot ellu leharbot qetzat baakila ushetiyya bayyom shelleachar hechag bekol shalosh regalim. Veen mitannin apillu chatan vekalla beyom chuppatam, velo taanit yom shemmet bo abiv veimmo, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tqs"ch vetaqa"g. Veissur zeh eno ella minhag, abal meiqqar haddin en issur kelal lehitannot bo, ella shehammonea hare zeh meshubbach, kemo shennitbaer:
Bammeh debarim amurim? Bayyom shelleachar happesach veshelleachar hassukkot, abal bayyom shelleachar chag hashshabuot, min haddin asur lehitannot bo, mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman ttz"d:

Yesh miggedole hammorim shehaya manhig libne doro sheyyihyu maprishin meat qemach min haqqemach shennitchan lepesach veyaasu mimmennu pat o tabshil veyokluhu qodem happesach. Vetob litten laaniyyim sheyyokluhu qodem happesach. Vetaam minhag zeh hu, kede sheap im yesh chashash chametz mashshehu betok haqqemach hazzeh nukal litlot velomar sheoto hachashash chametz haya kullo betok hammiqtzat shenneekal kebar qodem happesach (kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tn"g vetas"v). Umikkol maqom minhag zeh eno ella chumra beolma, shemmeiqqar haddin en anu machaziqin reuta lachosh shemma yesh baqqemach chashash chimmutz mashshehu.
